key_terms.sampling: ONE streaming reqMktData subscription on conId 69067924 (1 of ~50 pacing budget); 1s sampling grid in IBKR server time; every received tick logged event-driven; empty grid cells are MISSING, never forward-filled; per-second snapshot polling forbidden
key_terms.timestamp: IBKR server time only (reqCurrentTime at connect + every 15 min + tick tags); local wall time recorded as secondary forensics only; drift checks at 250 ms threshold
key_terms.minimum_window: >= 10 trading days spanning mid-month AND month-end, plus >= 1 FOMC/CPI/NFP-class event day captured 60 min pre / 120 min post (window extended until an event day is captured - mandatory)
key_terms.sessions: Asia/London/NY in US/Eastern with frozen boundaries (17-02 / 02-08 / 08-17) + mandatory low-liquidity rollover bucket 16:55-17:15 ET; 7 bounded daily windows named
key_terms.regimes: session x {quiet, normal, high_vol}; R1 calendar-forced high-vol (event +/- 120 min); R2 threshold T = P95 |1-min mid log-return| from probe days 1-2, frozen at day-2 close before any analysis; no post-hoc rebinning; TD archive barred from setting T
key_terms.stress: 2.0 multiplier on per-regime median spread, frozen NOW before any distribution exists (program stress tier standard); single live sample never applicable to history
key_terms.spread: recorded in USD/oz AND bps-of-mid; per-session and per-hour-bucket median/p90/p95/p99/max with n_observed/invalid/coverage; minTick=0.01 audit on every price with identity-alarm halt
key_terms.reconnect: gap records with last/first good server ts; no resume-mid-second; server resync before first post-reconnect sample; RESUME event mandatory
key_terms.pacing: streaming only; pacing error codes 100/101/102 => halt + 600 s backoff + log; 3 violations/day => day PARTIAL
